en.tool.description: Read a BACnet property from a device. Returns the current value and metadata as JSON or text.
en.param.device_instance.description: BACnet device instance number (alternative to ip). Used if ip is not provided.
en.param.property_name.description: Property name to read (default: 'presentValue'). Common: presentValue, description, units, statusFlags, objectName.
en.err.bac0_install: BAC0 library could not be installed.
en.err.ip_or_device_required: Either ip or device_instance is required.
